name: m5-zd-k
description: Zinc's own time by phase and the effect of concurrent compiles: K copies of Pekko 1.7.1's `stream` compiled at the same time in one JVM through Zinc's API, K in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, at the two corners Zinc 1.12.1 + Scala 2.13.18 and Zinc 1.13.0 + the Scala tip. Approximate (3 warmup ops, 5 measured; the pilot's K=1 plateaus by op 3 and K=8 by op 4). See labs/zinc-direct/README.md.
